No hidden fees. View absolute prices in GHS and connect with merchants directly.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I verify if a part fits my car model?
You can use our vehicle lookup selector at the top hero section. Choose your vehicle's Brand, Model, and Year to instantly filter components that match your specific fitment specifications. We also display compatibility tags on each listing.
How does buying and negotiating via WhatsApp work?
Clicking the "Chat Merchant on WhatsApp" button on any listing opens a direct chat window with the verified Abossey Okai seller, pre-filling details about the exact item and price. You can complete the sale details and delivery options directly with them.
Are the products listed brand new or used?
Both! We offer filters for "New", "Used" (salvage/tokunbo), and "Refurbished" conditions to accommodate different budgetary needs. The condition badge is displayed on each card.
Can I locate physical stores in Abossey Okai?
Yes! Every listing from verified merchant stalls includes a "Locate Merchant Shop" button which opens coordinates directly inside Google Maps, helping you navigate to the dealer's stall in Abossey Okai, Accra.
